description: Full matched-seed Phase Four causal campaign asking whether local resource sensing alters evolved movement execution and spatial/resource outcomes when locomotion is available. Both conditions expose SENSE_RESOURCE and MOVE_X/MOVE_Y to hereditary mutation, both execute movement with calibrated unit-step mutation and atomic payment in the same center-patch environment, and only resource-sensing execution differs. The sensor reports only the scalar resource level at the current location; this campaign does not test or claim directional navigation.
